text:
maria: Heads-up — ran a cross-region capacity drill this morning and noticed our Grafana dashboard buries transient Xid/ECC spikes. When a network blip hits a rack we lose signal at the card panel and alerts either never fire or flood. Can we rework the dashboard + SLOs to catch these transient but impactful events?

alex: Agreed. Right now panels are 1h aggregates which smooths short bursts. Propose adding a 5m spike panel and a burst-rate alert that ties Xid to eviction/drain events. Example query to start with:```promql
sum by(card, region) (increase(nvidia_xid_errors_total[5m])) / max(1, sum by(card, region) (increase(nvidia_requests_total[5m])))
```This gives a per-card error ratio over 5m.

jon: For alerts we should reduce flapping: fire on sustained 5m spike followed by a second 10m window if evictions increase. Something like: if xid_ratio > 0.03 for 5m AND evictions > 0.5/hr then severity=P1, else P2. Also add a suppression window for maintenance tags.

sam: Dashboards: add these panels — Xid spike heatmap (by rack/card), temp/PCIe-errors side-by-side, drain/start-counts, and cross-region fallback rate. Make the heatmap use 30s scrape resolution so we don't miss spikes.

maria: SLO thought: GPU availability SLO per-region = 99.95% measured as weighted healthy-card-minutes / provisioned-card-minutes. We need to define "healthy" = no ECC/Xid spike + not in scheduled drain + below thermal threshold. If one region drops below SLO, automatic routing should shift 10% of traffic to fallback region within 2m.

tasha: Ops runbook additions: quick checks for transient network-induced Xid: 1) look at nic/tor packet drops (if >1% in 1m, correlate), 2) check rack PS and inlet temp spikes, 3) check k8s eviction events and scheduling failures. Add sample kubectl and iperf commands in the runbook.

alex: Also add an aggregated noise metric to avoid alert fatigue: compute 7d baseline of 5m xid spike count per card and only alert if current 5m is > 4x baseline OR absolute > threshold. That kills noisy cards vs real regressions.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: grafana/dashboard/gpu-fallback-panel v1.3 deployed to staging at 1746254500 :rocket:

jon: After staging validation we should run a synthetic blip drill with the new panels visible to oncall. Schedule a 30m window tomorrow 10:30 PT and tag eng-sre + oncall. If it looks good we promote to prod and update the SLO calc script at /infra/slo/gpu_availability_calc.

maria: Excellent — I'll mock the 5m panels and post a screenshot to this thread for feedback before the drill. Thanks all :thumbsup:
